trafficScenarios.name: 50000-total-pv-30000-home
trafficScenarios.assumption: 60% of 50000 total page views reach home; prefetch, bots, preview deployment traffic and extra route requests must be included separately if present.

trafficScenarios.name: 50000-total-pv-all-home
trafficScenarios.assumption: All 50000 page views reach home; this is a traffic sensitivity, not an assertion of production page mix.

assumptions: Frozen 2026-10-04 budget scenario: devlog/latest observations and reserve references describe the measured source at that date, not the current browser contract. Issue 148 removes the unread endpoint chain in new builds. Historical inputs and arithmetic remain unchanged until a new paired resource ledger and production usage calibrate the forecast; no request or CPU saving is assumed from removal alone.
Topology remains Vercel for Web, images, JavaScript, CSS, fonts, and icons. No separate static CDN is included.
31-day window and persistent per-scope 1800-second gate permit at most 1489 accepted invalidation claims including a window-boundary allowance. Stats and urgent changes share the same gate.

The API database stores monotonic receiver claims before Web invalidation. Duplicate and old revisions cannot claim again across Web instances; six successful transport deliveries do not mean six invalidations.
Claim-before-invalidate is at-most-once: a crash after claim can lose that invalidation. The unchanged 3600-second TTL supplies recovery opportunities; no immediate browser push is required.
3100 business changes/month are delivery workload demand, not accepted invalidations. The actual invalidation cap remains 1489 when business demand or replay attempts rise.
Required forecast includes two changed generations per accepted invalidation. That allowance is a sensitivity, not a proven Vercel hard maximum.

All complete observed local route files are conservatively included as 22 independently rounded units/generation. gzip and HTML/RSC-only sizes are lower-size sensitivities; storage compression and object grouping require Vercel usage calibration.
The 10000-unit project reserve includes /api/devlog/latest, deployment effects and other unmeasured project ISR. This is an allowance, not enumerated proof of every route or active deployment.
150 monthly deployments and a 1.2 uncertainty multiplier are forward assumptions. Multiple still-active deployments, bots and larger output must be added when actual data requires it.
No unchanged-content credit is taken: local Sentry trace metadata changed on otherwise repeated renders. Data Cache Reads/Writes are not classified as billed ISR Writes.
Other team future ISR Writes remain unknown. Project conditional capacity cannot establish account capacity or measured production effectiveness.
